# m.stocks.dividends

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Cash dividends of US-listed stocks, one row per distribution.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.stocks.dividends(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Id`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Stock tickers; leave it out for every ticker. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first ex-dividend date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last ex-dividend date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any of Massive's field names, such as `"pay_date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. With a watchlist, `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"distribution_type": "special"}`. Keys: `distribution_type`, `distribution_type_any_of`, `frequency`, `frequency_gt`, `frequency_gte`, `frequency_lt`, `frequency_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Dividends (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "Stock symbol for the company issuing the dividend". |
| `CashAmount` | double | Original dividend amount per share in the specified currency |
| `Currency` | String | Currency code for the dividend payment (e.g., USD, CAD) |
| `DeclarationDate` | String | Date when the company officially announced the dividend |
| `DistributionType` | String | Classification describing the nature of this dividend's recurrence pattern: recurring (paid on a regular schedule), special (one-time or commemorative), supplemental (extra beyond the regular schedule), irregular (unpredictable or non-recurring), unknown (cannot be classified from available data) |
| `ExDividendDate` | String | Date when the stock begins trading without the dividend value |
| `Frequency` | long | How many times per year this dividend is expected to occur. A value of 0 means the distribution is non-recurring or irregular (e.g., special, supplemental, or a one-off dividend). Other possible values include 1 (annual), 2 (semi-annual), 3 (trimester), 4 (quarterly), 12 (monthly), 24 (bi-monthly), 52 (weekly), 104 (bi-weekly), and 365 (daily) depending on the issuer's declared or inferred payout cadence. |
| `HistoricalAdjustmentFactor` | double | Cumulative adjustment factor used to offset dividend effects on historical prices. To adjust a historical price for dividends: for a price on date D, find the first dividend whose `ex_dividend_date` is after date D and multiply the price by that dividend's `historical_adjustment_factor`. |
| `Id` | String | Unique identifier for each dividend record |
| `PayDate` | String | Date when the dividend payment is distributed to shareholders |
| `RecordDate` | String | Date when shareholders must be on record to be eligible for the dividend payment |
| `SplitAdjustedCashAmount` | double | Dividend amount adjusted for stock splits that occurred after the dividend was paid, expressed on a current share basis |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
